title: Buddhist Women Beyond Boundaries
subtitle: Interfaith, Interdependence, and Environment
about: Held entirely online during the pandemic, the 17th conference connected over 1,200 participants from 38 countries in seven working languages. Sessions explored interfaith dialogue, interdependence, and the environment — proving that the Sakyadhita community could gather and flourish across any boundary.

coverage.headline: Sakyadhita International Association of Buddhist Women Holds First Virtual Conference
coverage.excerpt: Over 1,000 monastics, laypeople, and practitioners from around the world gathered online for the 17th biennial conference to discuss gender equality issues in Buddhism.
